Name: FabLab Marawi
Description: Fab Lab Marawi is a digital fabrication and arts innovation center established through a collaboration between Mindanao State University – Main (MSU-Marawi) and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), under MSU-Marawi’s Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research, Extension, and Development (OVCRED). Located at Macarambon Hall, 1st Street, MSU Marawi City, the lab was established with a deliberate and distinctive purpose: to serve as a center for reconstruction, economic empowerment, and cultural innovation for Marawi and Lanao del Sur — particularly for MSMEs and communities affected by the 2017 Marawi Siege.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-BSU Agriculture & Food TBI
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-BSU Agriculture & Food TBI (now also operating as an Innovation Center, ATBI/IC) is hosted by Benguet State University in La Trinidad, Benguet and serves the Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR). Established under the DOST-PCAARRD ATBI Program, BSU ATBI/IC provides a stimulating physical environment and professional support services for start-up and early-stage micro-scale agricultural and food enterprises.

Name: FabLab SLU — Saint Louis University
Description: FabLab SLU is the digital fabrication laboratory of Saint Louis University, operating under the SLU Engineering Institute and Shared Service Infrastructure Facilities (EISSIF) in Baguio City. Established through the DTI Shared Service Facilities (SSF) program, FabLab SLU is registered on the global fablabs.io directory and serves as SLU's hands-on innovation and prototyping facility in the Cordillera Administrative Region.

Name: Food Science Research and Innovation Center — Benguet State University
Description: The Food Science Research and Innovation Center (FSRIC) at Benguet State University is the Cordillera Administrative Region's designated Food Innovation Center under the DOST network. Located at Km. 6, La Trinidad, Benguet — the heart of the Philippines' premier highland vegetable and strawberry production zone — the FSRIC was formally launched in April 2018.

Name: SIRIB Center — Saint Louis University
Description: The SIRIB Center (SLU Incubator for Research, Innovation & Business) is Saint Louis University's technology business incubator and the primary innovation support platform for startups and research-based ventures in the Cordillera Administrative Region. Based at SLU's campus in Baguio City, the SIRIB Center anchors its work in highland engineering, sustainable technology, and the unique innovation landscape of the Cordillera.

Name: UCIANS — UC Innovation & Nurturing Space (TBI)
Description: UCIANS (UC Innovation & Nurturing Space) is the Technology Business Incubator and innovation hub of the University of the Cordilleras (UC) in Baguio City, operating under the University's Innovation, Technology Transfer, and Entrepreneurship Office (InTTO). UCIANS serves as the primary platform for cultivating startups, student entrepreneurs, and technology ventures at UC — translating the university's academic research and student innovation into commercially viable businesses that contribute to the Cordillera region's economy.

Name: UP Baguio SILBI TBI
Description: UP Baguio TBI, known as SILBI (Social Innovation Laboratory and Business Inclusion), is the Technology Business Incubator hosted by the University of the Philippines Baguio in Baguio City, Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR). Established under the DOST-PCIEERD Higher Education Institution Readiness for Innovation and Technopreneurship (HEIRIT) program, SILBI serves as a nurturing space for local artisans, crafters, and startups to grow their businesses while promoting and protecting traditional crafts.

Name: Adamson NEST — Neo Science & Technology Incubation Center
Description: NEST (Neo Science and Technology Incubation Center) — formally incorporated as AdUNEST Inc. — is the Technology Business Incubator of Adamson University in Manila, serving the National Capital Region. NEST is part of the SCALE-NCR (Strategic and Collaborative Alliance for Leveraging the Ecosystem of Startups – NCR) consortium, a DOST-NCR-supported network of Metro Manila TBIs that includes TIP NITRO (lead), DLSU Animo Labs, UST TOMASInno Center, Mapua Think and Tinker Lab, UPD UPSCALE Innovation Hub, MC TBI, and QBO Innovation Hub.

Name: AIM–Dado Banatao Incubator
Description: The AIM–Dado Banatao Incubator is a premier technology startup incubator hosted by the Asian Institute of Management (AIM) in Makati City. Named after legendary Filipino technologist and venture capitalist Dado Banatao, the incubator focuses on nurturing early-stage technology ventures with high commercial potential across Southeast Asia.

Name: Brainsparks
Description: Brainsparks is a startup incubator and accelerator based in Metro Manila, founded in 2015 to support Filipino founders driving impactful innovation. It positions itself as an innovation ecosystem booster, helping early-stage entrepreneurs build the foundation, mindset, and principles for sustainable growth.

Name: DLSU Animo Labs — TBI & FabLab
Description: Animo Labs is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) and digital fabrication laboratory (FabLab) of De La Salle University, established in partnership with DOST-PCIEERD. Located primarily at the DLSU Manila campus in Taft Avenue, Manila (with facilities also at the Laguna campus), Animo Labs serves as DLSU's flagship innovation and entrepreneurship center — supporting student and community innovators from idea validation to prototype development to market-ready startup.

Name: DOST-PUP TBI Pylon Hub
Description: The DOST-PUP TBI Pylon Hub — full name: PUP Technology Business Incubation Product Innovation Yielding to Long-Term Opportunities for New Entrepreneurs Hub — is the Technology Business Incubator of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines (PUP) in Manila, serving the National Capital Region. Established through a grant from DOST-PCIEERD, Pylon Hub promotes innovation and technopreneurship at PUP, turning student and early-stage founder ideas into commercially viable businesses.

Name: FabLab PFFI
Description: FabLab PFFI is the industry-embedded fabrication laboratory of the Philippine Footwear Federation Inc. (PFFI), located in Marikina City — the undisputed shoe capital of the Philippines and the heart of the country's footwear manufacturing industry. Unlike most Philippine FabLabs hosted by universities or state colleges, FabLab PFFI is operated by an industry association, making it a uniquely sector-focused fabrication facility designed to serve Marikina's footwear ecosystem.

Name: HiFi — Hub of Innovation for Inclusion
Description: HiFi — Hub of Innovation for Inclusion is a DOST-accredited Technology Business Incubator hosted by De La Salle-College of Saint Benilde in Malate, Manila (NCR). Founded in 2016 and housed at the Peter D. Garrucho Innovations Institute, HiFi is dedicated to driving social innovation and inclusion, nurturing financially viable startups into sustainable enterprises.

Name: IdeaSpace Foundation (Incubator Hub)
Description: IdeaSpace Foundation is a non-profit technology business incubator and startup accelerator based in Makati City, Metro Manila. Established in 2012 and backed by the MVP Group of Companies — including First Pacific, Metro Pacific Investments Corporation, PLDT-Smart, and Meralco — it supports early-stage Filipino tech entrepreneurs solving problems in emerging markets.

Name: PTTC DigiFab
Description: PTTC DigiFab is the digital fabrication facility of the Philippine Trade Training Center (PTTC), the training arm of the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), located in Pasay City, Metro Manila. As a government-run Fab Lab under a major trade and industry agency, PTTC DigiFab uniquely targets MSMEs and entrepreneurs seeking to bridge the gap between product ideation and market-ready production — positioning it as one of the most commercially oriented Fab Labs in the National Capital Region.

Name: QBO Innovation Hub
Description: QBO Innovation Hub is the Philippines' first public-private startup platform, established through a tri-sector founding partnership between DOST-PCIEERD (government), IdeaSpace (civil society), and J.P. Morgan and DTI (private sector and government). Now operating as a division of Ideaspace under the brand QBO Innovation, the hub has been a pillar of the Philippine startup ecosystem since 2016 — based at Zero-Ten Park, Legazpi Village, Makati City, in the heart of Metro Manila's business and technology district.

Name: T.I.P. TechnoCoRe (Student Incubation)
Description: The TechnoCoRe Catalyst Office is the in-house student and startup incubation arm of the Technological Institute of the Philippines (TIP) in Quezon City. Operating within TIP TechnoCoRe (Technopreneurship and Collaborative Applied Research), it houses the university's Innovation and Technology Support Office (ITSO) and technopreneurship programs, supporting TIP student and faculty innovators from idea development through intellectual property protection and startup formation.

Name: TBI Center at Miriam College — Henry Sy Sr. Innovation Center
Description: The TBI Center at Miriam College, housed in the Henry Sy Sr. Innovation Center, is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of Miriam College — located along Katipunan Avenue in Quezon City. As part of the DOST-PCIEERD DOST-PCIEERD HEIRIT program of Metro Manila TBIs, the center supports technology entrepreneurship among Miriam College students and alumni in alignment with the college's mission of women's education and sustainable development.

Name: Think & Tinker Laboratory — Mapúá University
Description: The Think & Tinker Laboratory is Mapúá University's DOST-PCIEERD-accredited Technology Business Incubator and a member of the SCALE-NCR cluster of startup incubators in Metro Manila. The lab's name captures its dual purpose: think (ideate, conceptualize, design) and tinker (prototype, build, test, iterate) — a pairing that reflects its focus on engineering-driven and deep-tech startup development.

Name: TIP NITRO — TBI
Description: TIP NITRO is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the Technological Institute of the Philippines (TIP), located in Quezon City. As part of the DOST-PCIEERD SCALE-NCR cluster of Metro Manila TBIs, TIP NITRO supports technology startup development among TIP engineering and technology students and alumni, channeling TIP's polytechnic strengths in engineering, ICT, and applied sciences into practical startup commercialization.

Name: TOMASInno Center TBI — UST
Description: TOMASInno Center is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the University of Santo Tomas (UST), located in Manila. Supported by DOST-PCIEERD, TOMASInno serves as UST's hub for technology entrepreneurship, startup incubation, and research commercialization — drawing on the vast academic resources of one of Asia's oldest universities (established 1611).

Name: UP Diliman–DOST Food Innovation Facility (FIF)
Description: The Food Innovation Facility (FIF) at the University of the Philippines Diliman is the Metro Manila–based center in the DOST national Food Innovation Center (FIC) network. Hosted by UP Diliman's College of Home Economics through the Department of Food Science and Nutrition (CHE-DFSN), the FIF is co-located with the Pilot Food Plant on the UP Diliman campus — giving it direct access to both research-grade processing infrastructure and the scientific expertise of the country's premier state university.

Name: UP-CFA FabLab
Description: The UP-CFA FabLab at the University of the Philippines Diliman — College of Fine Arts (CFA) is a digital fabrication laboratory that brings together the creative disciplines of fine arts and design with modern digital manufacturing technology. Located within the CFA campus in Quezon City, the FabLab serves as a maker space and prototyping hub for UP's art, design, and creative students and faculty, listed on the global fablabs.io directory as part of the worldwide Fab Lab network.

Name: UPScale Innovation Hub
Description: UPScale Innovation Hub is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the University of the Philippines Diliman, housed within the College of Engineering and backed by DOST-PCIEERD. As one of the Philippines' most prestigious university-based TBIs, UPScale supports high-potential engineering-driven startups and student innovators from one of the country's top engineering faculties, with access to UP Diliman's research facilities, faculty experts, and alumni network.

Name: Aligwas TBI
Description: Aligwas TBI (DOST-PSU Aligwas Technology Business Incubator) is hosted by Pangasinan State University (PSU) in Region I (Ilocos Region), with operations anchored at PSU and its Bayambang campus, serving Lingayen and the wider Pangasinan province. "Aligwas" is a local word meaning "progress" or "advancement," reflecting the center's mission to drive innovation, entrepreneurship, and sustainable solutions.

Name: DOST-MMSU Bannuar Technology Business Incubator
Description: The DOST-MMSU Technology Business Incubator — known as the Bannuar TBI — is hosted by Mariano Marcos State University in Batac, Ilocos Norte and serves Region I (Ilocos). Established through a ₱12.7 million grant from DOST-PCIEERD, the Bannuar TBI was inaugurated at MMSU to spur innovation and empower the creative manufacturing industry in the Ilocos Region. "Bannuar" is an Ilocano word meaning excellent or distinguished, reflecting the TBI's aspiration to be a premier incubation center in Northern Luzon.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-DMMMSU Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator (ATBI)
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-DMMMSU Agri, Aquaculture & Food TBI is hosted by Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State University (DMMMSU) in Rosario, La Union and serves as the Regional Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator for Region I (Ilocos). Established under the DOST-PCAARRD RAISE (Regional Agri-Aqua Innovation System Enhancement) Program, DMMMSU-ATBI functions as a regional hub for technology transfer, commercialization, and agri-aqua enterprise development across the Ilocos Region.

Name: MMSU FARM-A Lab (Fabrication and Automation Research for the Mechanization of Agriculture)
Description: The FARM-A Lab (Fabrication and Automation Research for the Mechanization of Agriculture) is a digital fabrication and applied-research facility at Mariano Marcos State University (MMSU) in Batac City, Ilocos Norte, intended to serve agricultural mechanisation and automation. The only public record found is MMSU's announcement of a partnership to build a 3D-printing laboratory, so this lab should be treated as proposed or under development until MMSU confirms it is operational.

Name: MMSU Food Innovation Center
Description: The MMSU Food Innovation Center (MMSU FIC) is the DOST-supported Food Innovation Center for Region I (Ilocos Region), hosted by Mariano Marcos State University (MMSU) in Batac City, Ilocos Norte. Established as part of DOST’s nationwide Food Innovation Center program, the MMSU FIC serves as a one-stop shop for food product development, food processing technology, and MSME support across the Ilocos region — helping local agri-food producers transform raw agricultural commodities into commercially viable, market-ready food products.

Name: PSU-DOST 1 FIC — Pangasinan State University
Description: The PSU-DOST 1 Food Innovation Center is hosted by Pangasinan State University at its Bayambang Campus in Bayambang, Pangasinan and serves Region I (Ilocos Region). One of PSU's ten flagship Research, Extension, and Innovation Centers, the PSU-DOST 1 FIC operates as the region's dedicated food processing and innovation hub — enabling Pangasinan's food producers, entrepreneurs, students, and researchers to access DOST-funded technology, equipment, and expertise for value-adding agri-fishery products.

Name: BIZNEST Technology Business Incubator (CSU)
Description: BIZNEST (Business Incubation Zone for Novel and Sustainable Enterprises) is hosted by Cagayan State University in Tuguegarao City, Cagayan and serves Region II (Cagayan Valley). Funded by DOST-PCIEERD, BIZNEST focuses primarily on entrepreneurs with food and post-harvest technologies — its banner program is Food and Post-harvest Technology — connecting innovators in the Cagayan Valley to the national technology business incubation ecosystem.

Name: Cagayan Valley Food Innovation Center (FIC)
Description: The Cagayan Valley Food Innovation Center (FIC) is hosted by Cagayan State University at its Carig Campus in Tuguegarao City, Cagayan and serves Region II (Cagayan Valley). Established in 2014, it holds the distinction of being the first Food Innovation Center in all of Luzon and the second FIC established in the Philippines — pioneering the DOST FIC model in Northern Luzon after the original FIC launched in Davao City.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-ISU Livestock TBI
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-ISU Livestock TBI is hosted by Isabela State University through its Cagayan Valley Small Ruminant Research Center (CVSRRC) in Echague, Isabela and serves Region II (Cagayan Valley). CVSRRC was established in 2010 by the ISU Board of Regents to lead research and development activities for improving the small ruminant industry in the region. In 2017, DOST-PCAARRD designated it as one of the six pioneering agriculture-based Technology Business Incubators in the country.

Name: FabLab Santiago City
Description: FabLab Santiago City is a digital fabrication center operated by the Local Government Unit of Santiago City, located in Santiago City, Isabela in the Cagayan Valley region. Listed on the global Fab Lab network directory (fablabs.io), the lab provides open access to fabrication equipment and digital design tools for entrepreneurs, students, artisans, and community members in Santiago City and the surrounding Cagayan Valley area.

Name: FIC — Isabela State University (Cauayan Campus)
Description: The Isabela State University Food Innovation Center (ISU FIC) is a DOST-supported food technology facility at Isabela State University, located at the Cauayan Campus in Cauayan City, Isabela. The center serves as Region II's key food innovation resource, supporting food MSMEs and agri-entrepreneurs in Isabela and the broader Cagayan Valley region.

Name: Sabatan — NVSU Technopreneurs Hub
Description: Sabatan — NVSU Technopreneurs Hub is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Nueva Vizcaya State University (NVSU) in Bayombong, Nueva Vizcaya. Under DOST's banner program for Metal Technologies, Sabatan supports student entrepreneurs, researchers, and MSMEs in developing innovations across metalworking, tooling, fabrication, and related manufacturing processes.

Name: BARAS TBI (Business Assistance for Research Acceleration & Sustainability)
Description: BARAS TBI (Business Assistance for Research Acceleration & Sustainability) is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Bulacan State University (BulSU) in Malolos, Bulacan. Under DOST's banner program for Industrial Technology, BARAS TBI supports entrepreneurs and innovators in sectors including food processing, jewelry making, furniture design, and other industrial crafts indigenous to Central Luzon.

Name: BulSU FABLAB Center
Description: The BulSU FABLAB Center — formally known as the Center for Fabrication and Manufacture — is Bulacan State University's digital fabrication laboratory, providing hands-on access to advanced manufacturing technologies for students, MSMEs, and the community in Malolos, Bulacan. The center's equipment suite spans metal, acrylic, wood, and plastic fabrication — encompassing subtractive milling, laser engraving, and 3D additive manufacturing — making it one of the more versatile fabrication facilities in Region III.

Name: DOST-NEUST TBI
Description: DOST-NEUST TBI is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by the Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology (NEUST) at its Sumacab Campus in Cabanatuan City, Nueva Ecija, Region III (Central Luzon). Operating alongside the university's Innovation Management Office (IMO) and Innovation and Technology Support Office, it nurtures technology-based startups and helps students and researchers turn ideas into market-ready prototypes and enterprises.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-CLSU Agriculture & Food TBI
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-CLSU Agriculture & Food TBI (AFTBI) is hosted by Central Luzon State University in the Science City of Muñoz, Nueva Ecija and serves Region III (Central Luzon). Funded by the Philippine Council for Agriculture, Aquatic and Natural Resources Research and Development (PCAARRD-DOST), CLSU AFTBI is designed to facilitate the transfer and commercialization of mature technologies developed by CLSU researchers, helping MSMEs grow and access larger markets locally and globally.

Name: DOST-TSU Aslagan TBI
Description: DOST-TSU Aslagan TBI is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Tarlac State University in Tarlac City, Region III (Central Luzon). Officially launched on July 24, 2023, the center takes its name "Aslagan," a Kapampangan term meaning "to light up," reflecting its mission to nurture entrepreneurs and innovators by providing a conducive environment and essential resources for building their businesses.

Name: Encephalon TBI
Description: Encephalon TBI is the Technology Business Incubator of Holy Angel University (HAU) in Angeles City, Pampanga, established with support from DOST-PCIEERD. Named after the Latin word for "brain," Encephalon reflects HAU's commitment to nurturing the brightest ideas and developing them into commercially viable technology-based ventures. With its dedicated website at encephalonhautbi.com and a dedicated Facebook page, Encephalon serves as the central innovation and startup hub for the Central Luzon region (Region III) among the Holy Angel University community.

Name: FabLab DHVTSU
Description: FabLab DHVTSU — now operating under Pampanga State University (PSU), formerly Don Honorio Ventura Technological State University — is the digital fabrication laboratory of Central Luzon's premier polytechnic state university in Bacolor, Pampanga. Managed under the university's Knowledge Management and Innovation Office (KMIO), the FabLab provides digital manufacturing tools and prototyping services to engineering students, faculty researchers, and MSMEs across Pampanga and the Central Luzon region.

Name: FIC — Bulacan State University
Description: The Bulacan State University Food Innovation Center (BulSU FIC) is a DOST-HITS (Harmonized Industrial Technology Services) recipient at Bulacan State University (BulSU) in Malolos, Bulacan, providing food product development and innovation services to MSMEs in Region III. Operating under BulSU's Office of VP for Research, Extension, and Innovation (OVPREI), the FIC serves as the university's flagship food technology hub — supporting food entrepreneurs and producers across Bulacan and the Central Luzon region.

Name: PSHS-CLC Innovation Center
Description: The PSHS-CLC Innovation Center is a fabrication laboratory (FabLab) established at the Philippine Science High School – Central Luzon Campus (PSHS-CLC) in Clark Freeport Zone, Mabalacat City, Pampanga. Operating as a Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Shared Service Facility (SSF), the center serves PSHS-CLC students as well as MSMEs and the creative industry in Region III, providing a digital fabrication facility that bridges science education with practical product innovation and entrepreneurship.

Name: SIKAT TBI
Description: SIKAT TBI is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Bataan Peninsula State University (BPSU) in Balanga City, Bataan, Region III (Central Luzon). Launched by the Department of Science and Technology, SIKAT (Synergizing Innovation and Creativity through Cultural Knowledge, Artistry, and Technology) is designed to bring together academia, government, and industry to strengthen the country's startup ecosystem through science, technology, and innovation. With its establishment, BPSU became one of the higher education institutions assisted by DOST to operate its own TBI.

Name: BatStateU Center for Technopreneurship & Innovation (CTI)
Description: The Center for Technopreneurship and Innovation (CTI) is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of Batangas State University – The National Engineering University, established in September 2014 in Batangas City. A DOST-PCIEERD-supported TBI located on the second floor of the STEER Hub Building at BatStateU Alangilan Campus, CTI is one of CALABARZON's flagship incubators — serving Region IV-A's startup ecosystem across Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal, and Quezon.

Name: CALABARZON Food Solutions Hub — C-FoSH (LSPU FIC)
Description: The CALABARZON Food Solutions Hub (C-FoSH) is a DOST-designated Food Innovation Center hosted by Laguna State Polytechnic University (LSPU) at its Sta. Cruz Campus in Sta. Cruz, Laguna. C-FoSH operates as a DTI Shared Service Facility (SSF) managed in partnership with the Association of Laguna Food Processors, Inc. (ALAFOP), LSPU, and DOST-CALABARZON — positioning it as a food processing center that serves the collaborative needs of the CALABARZON food processing industry.

Name: Cavite State University Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator (CvSU-ATBI)
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-CvSU Agriculture & Food TBI is hosted by Cavite State University in Indang, Cavite and serves Region IV-A (CALABARZON). Implemented through CvSU's CEMDS and CAFENR units, the center is part of the DOST-PCAARRD national Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubation (ATBI) network under the RAISE IV programme.

Name: DLSU-D CEAT Center of Technology (CCTI Fab Lab)
Description: The DLSU-D SSF Innovation Laboratory — branded the CEAT Center for Technological Innovation (CCTI) — is a fabrication laboratory hosted by De La Salle University-Dasmariñas within its College of Engineering, Architecture, and Technology (CEAT) in Dasmariñas, Cavite (Region IV-A). Established under the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Shared Service Facility (SSF) Program through a Memorandum of Agreement signed with DTI-Region 4A in April 2021, the P24-million InnoLab held its soft launch on December 21, 2021, and stands as one of the first major fabrication laboratories in Cavite.

Name: DOST-FPRDI Tubo Forest Products Technology Business Incubator (FPTBI)
Description: The DOST-FPRDI Technology Business Incubator — officially rebranded as Tubò in September 2023 — is hosted by the DOST Forest Products Research and Development Institute (DOST-FPRDI) on the campus of the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) in Los Baños, Laguna. FPRDI was founded in 1954 as the Forest Products Laboratory and has since grown into the country's premier research institute for the forest products sector.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD LSPU Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator (LSPU ATBI)
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-LSPU TBI Hub (Agri-Fishery & Natural Products) is a DOST-PCAARRD-funded Technology Business Incubator hosted by Laguna State Polytechnic University (LSPU) in Siniloan, Laguna. Part of the DOST-PCAARRD AANR TBI network, the LSPU TBI Hub focuses on incubating agri-fishery and natural products technology ventures in the CALABARZON region (Region IV-A) — a region where Laguna Lake’s fisheries, rice-based agribusiness, and natural products industries represent significant economic opportunities.

Name: Food Innovation Center – Batangas State University
Description: CALABARZON FIC — Batangas State University is hosted by Batangas State University (The National Engineering University) in Batangas City. It serves as the region's DOST/DTI Food Innovation Center, supporting CALABARZON MSMEs with food product development, processing, and packaging. It is part of the nationwide food innovation center network surfaced in the Startupreneur Innovation Hub.

Name: IDEA FabLab — Antipolo Institute of Technology
Description: IDEA FabLab is the digital fabrication laboratory of the Antipolo Institute of Technology (AiTech), located in Antipolo City, Rizal in the CALABARZON region. The name IDEA reflects the center's focus on Innovation Design Engineering and Art — serving as AiTech's hands-on innovation hub for student engineers, technology entrepreneurs, and MSMEs in eastern Metro Manila and Rizal province.

Name: LIKHA FabLab
Description: LIKHA FabLab — which stands for Labspace for Innovation, Knowledge-Honing and Application — is a digital fabrication laboratory hosted by Batangas State University (The National Engineering University) at its Alangilan Campus in Batangas City. Established on December 27, 2018 as a Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Shared Service Facility (SSF), LIKHA FabLab is housed at the ground floor of the STEER Hub Building at BatStateU and serves Region IV-A (CALABARZON).

Name: UPLB SIBOL Labs (UPLB TTBDO)
Description: UPLB SIBOL (Startup Innovation and Business Opportunity Linkage) Innovation Hub is the University of the Philippines Los Baños's premier business incubation program, operating as the commercialization and startup support arm of the UPLB Technology Transfer and Business Development Office (UP TTBDO). Located in Los Baños, Laguna — at the heart of one of the Philippines' most concentrated agri-science research ecosystems — SIBOL provides a structured incubation pathway for startup enterprises emerging from UPLB's agricultural biotechnology, food systems, dairy science, and information and communications technology research programs.

Name: DOST-MIMAROPA Food Innovation Center (MinSU)
Description: The DOST-MIMAROPA Food Innovation Center (FIC) is housed at Mindoro State University (MinSU) in Victoria, Oriental Mindoro — formerly known as Mindoro State College of Agriculture and Technology (MinSCAT). Established under the DOST Food Innovation Center program, the center equips MinSU with DOST-developed food processing technologies — including a vacuum fryer, water retort, and spray dryer — enabling the development of new food products from MIMAROPA's abundant agricultural produce, tropical fruits, root crops, and marine resources.

Name: Palawan International Technology Business Incubator (PITBI)
Description: The Palawan International Technology Business Incubator (PITBI) is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of Palawan State University (PSU), located in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan. Established with support from DOST, PITBI is one of the few TBIs in the country with an explicitly international orientation — designed to connect Palawan-based startups, researchers, and innovators with global markets, international funding, and cross-border technology partnerships.

Name: WPU-ATBI (Western Philippines University Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator)
Description: Western Philippines University runs its agriculture and aquaculture incubation work under two distinct public brands, operated by the same team out of the WPU-ATBI Office at the ABBA R&D Center, WPU Puerto Princesa Campus (Pajara, Sta. Monica, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan 5300).

Name: AdZU AZUL Hub (TBI)
Description: AZUL Hub is the Technology Business Incubator of Ateneo de Zamboanga University, launched in 2023 with backing from DOST-PCIEERD. It describes itself as "a space for young professionals, entrepreneurs, innovators, development workers, students, faculty, and researchers in Zamboanga City, Region 9, and Western BARMM interested in participating in technology-based and innovation-driven businesses."

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-WMSU Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator (ATBI)
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-WMSU Agriculture & Food TBI is hosted by Western Mindanao State University in Zamboanga City and serves the Zamboanga Peninsula (Region IX). Established under the DOST-PCAARRD national Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubation (ATBI) Program, WMSU-ATBI provides emerging technopreneurs in the region with food and agricultural technology incubation services — translating mature AANR innovations into commercially viable businesses.

Name: FabLab Dapitan
Description: FabLab Dapitan is the digital fabrication laboratory of Jose Rizal Memorial State University (JRMSU) in Dapitan City, Zamboanga del Norte. Part of the global Fab Lab network and the nationwide DOST/DTI-supported fabrication infrastructure in the Philippines, FabLab Dapitan brings advanced digital manufacturing tools to Western Mindanao, serving students, MSMEs, and innovators in the Zamboanga Peninsula (Region IX).

Name: FabLab Pagadian — JHCSC
Description: FabLab Pagadian is the digital fabrication laboratory of Josefina H. Cerilles State College (JHCSC), located in Pagadian City in the Zamboanga Peninsula (Region IX). As the primary higher education institution in Zamboanga del Sur and a key state university in western Mindanao, JHCSC operates the FabLab as a resource for student innovation and MSME support in the manufacturing and technology sector of the Peninsula.

Name: WMSU Advanced Manufacturing Center (AMCen) / RICME (IC)
Description: The WMSU Advanced Manufacturing Center (AMCen) — co-housed with the Western Mindanao State University Regional Innovation Center for Metals and Engineering (RICME) — is the first Advanced Manufacturing Center in the Zamboanga Peninsula and the ninth nationwide, officially launched in September 2025 through a partnership between DOST-MIRDC, DOST Region IX, and Western Mindanao State University in Zamboanga City. The center brings cutting-edge 3D printing and additive manufacturing technology to the ZamPen region for the first time, with RICME providing its permanent institutional home within WMSU.

Name: Zamboanga Peninsula FIC — ZSCMST
Description: The Zamboanga Peninsula Food Innovation Center (ZamPen FIC) is a DOST-supported Food Innovation Center (FIC) hosted by Zamboanga State College of Marine Sciences and Technology (ZSCMST), located in Zamboanga City, Region IX. As the peninsula's primary FIC, ZamPen FIC serves MSME food producers across the Zamboanga Peninsula — a region whose coastal identity gives the center a distinctive focus on marine-based food products.

Name: Zampen FabLab — ZCSPC
Description: Zampen FabLab — short for Zamboanga Peninsula FabLab — is the digital fabrication laboratory of Zamboanga City State Polytechnic College (ZCSPC), located in Zamboanga City in the Zamboanga Peninsula (Region IX). Listed on the global fablabs.io directory as the representative fabrication laboratory of the Zamboanga Peninsula, Zampen FabLab provides advanced digital manufacturing tools to students, engineering faculty, and local entrepreneurs in Zamboanga City and the surrounding peninsula.

Name: Bicol Regional Food Innovation & Commercialization Center (BRFICC) — Bicol University
Description: The Bicol Regional Food Innovation & Commercialization Center (BRFICC) — also known as BRFIC since its 2024 renaming — is Bicol University’s DOST Food Innovation Center in Legazpi City, Albay. As the designated regional food innovation center for Region V, BRFICC serves food MSMEs, farmer cooperatives, and agri-food entrepreneurs across Albay, Camarines Sur, Camarines Norte, Sorsogon, Catanduanes, and Masbate — helping them develop and commercialize food products from Bicol’s rich agricultural base.

Name: Bicol University TBI / SILI DELI
Description: SILI DELI — Bicol University's Technology Business Incubator — is hosted by Bicol University in Legazpi City, Albay and is the first Technology Business Incubator established in the Bicol Region. Funded by DOST-PCIEERD under the HEIRIT Program and located at the BU Student Union Center, SILI DELI was purpose-built to support early-stage food innovation and technology-based business ventures in Bicol.

Name: BISCAST FabLab
Description: The BISCAST FabLab (also known as BISCAST ManFabLab) is the digital fabrication laboratory of Bicol State College of Applied Sciences and Technology (BISCAST) in Naga City, Camarines Sur. As part of the nationwide Fab Lab network, the center provides access to advanced digital fabrication and prototyping tools for students, MSMEs, and community innovators in the Bicol Region.

Name: CNSC FABMANLAB (Camarines Norte State College)
Description: FabLab Cam Norte is the fabrication laboratory of Camarines Norte State College (CNSC) in Daet, Camarines Norte — now operating as the CNSC Fabrication & Manufacturing Research Center (FMRC). As a member of the global Fab Lab network (listed at fablabs.io/labs/cnscfabmanlab), FabLab Cam Norte provides Camarines Norte with open access to digital fabrication equipment, empowering students, entrepreneurs, MSMEs, and community innovators to design and produce their ideas.

Name: CSPC ASOG Technology Business Incubator
Description: The CSPC ASOG Technology Business Incubator is hosted by Camarines Sur Polytechnic Colleges (CSPC) in Nabua, Camarines Sur and serves the Bicol Region (Region V). Funded by DOST-PCIEERD under the HEIRIT (Higher Education Institution Readiness for Innovation and Technopreneurship) Program, ASOG TBI formally launched its Incubation Center on March 23, 2026 at the CSPC Auditorium — marking a milestone in CSPC's commitment to advancing innovation and entrepreneurship in Bicol.

Name: FabLab Bicol — Bicol University
Description: FabLab Bicol is the digital fabrication laboratory of Bicol University's College of Industrial Technology (BUCIT), located in Legazpi City, Albay in the Bicol Region (Region V). Listed on the global fablabs.io directory as one of the Philippines' internationally recognized fabrication laboratories, FabLab Bicol serves as Bicol University's hands-on innovation and prototyping hub.

Name: MAGIS Technology Business Incubator (TBI)
Description: The MAGIS Technology Business Incubator (TBI) is the startup incubation center of Ateneo de Naga University (ADNU) in Naga City, Camarines Sur. Supported by DOST-PCIEERD under the HEIRIT (Higher Education Institution Readiness for Innovation & Technopreneurship) Program, MAGIS TBI nurtures technology-based startups and technopreneurs in the Bicol Region. The center operates under Ateneo de Naga's commitment to social entrepreneurship and magis — doing more for the greater good — connecting Bicolano innovators to funding, mentoring, and market development resources.

Name: Sorsogon PILI FabLab (SorSU)
Description: Sorsogon PILI FabLab — named for the pili nut (Canarium ovatum), Sorsogon's flagship commodity — is the digital fabrication laboratory of Sorsogon State University (SorSU) in Sorsogon City, the capital of Sorsogon Province at the southernmost tip of the Bicol Peninsula. Operated through the university's Shared Service Center (SSC), the FabLab provides modern digital manufacturing tools and prototyping services to engineering students, faculty, and local entrepreneurs in Sorsogon and the Bicol region.

Name: TIGRE Technology Business Incubator (NCF)
Description: TIGRE TBI is the Technology Business Incubator of Naga College Foundation (NCF) in Naga City, Camarines Sur. Supported by DOST, TIGRE TBI operates as NCF's official startup hub, committed to building a thriving technology entrepreneurship ecosystem in the Bicol Region. The center runs structured incubation cohort programs — including the Geronimo cohort and the NEXUS initiative in partnership with DTI — providing aspiring entrepreneurs with the tools, mentorship, and network needed to launch scalable tech-based and social enterprises.

Name: Advanced Manufacturing Center (AMCen) Western Visayas
Description: The WVSU Advanced Manufacturing Center is a DOST-supported digital fabrication and advanced manufacturing facility at West Visayas State University (WVSU), located in La Paz, Iloilo City in Western Visayas (Region VI). The center extends WVSU's engineering and technology programs into advanced manufacturing, providing digital fabrication tools and technical support to students, faculty researchers, and MSMEs in Iloilo City and the broader Western Visayas region.

Name: Aklan Innovators Hub FabLab
Description: The Aklan Innovators Hub FabLab is the digital fabrication laboratory of Aklan State University (ASU) in Banga, Aklan. Established with a PHP 18.5 million investment as one of the DTI- and DOST-supported Fab Labs in Western Visayas, it serves as the fourth Fab Lab in the region — expanding access to advanced manufacturing and prototyping infrastructure for inventors, startups, students, and MSMEs across Aklan Province.

Name: Capiz Innovation Center FabLab
Description: The Capiz Innovation Center FabLab is a fabrication laboratory operated by the Provincial Government of Capiz in Roxas City, Capiz. It is the province's dedicated digital fabrication and prototyping facility, providing Capiz residents, entrepreneurs, students, and MSMEs with access to digital manufacturing equipment and creative technology tools. The center is active at facebook.com/capizinnovate and can be reached at (036) 520-2584 or capizinnovate@gmail.com for service appointments and inquiries.

Name: COASTLINE 5023 — UPV Fisheries Technology Business Incubator (FTBI)
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-UPV Fisheries Technology Business Incubator (UPV Fisheries TBI) is a DOST-PCAARRD-funded TBI hosted by UP Visayas in Miagao, Iloilo. As part of the DOST-PCAARRD AANR TBI network, the UPV Fisheries TBI focuses exclusively on incubating fisheries technology ventures — leveraging UP Visayas’s internationally recognized expertise in marine science, fisheries, and aquaculture to support innovators in Western Visayas and beyond.

Name: CPU CPUGAD Technology Business Incubator
Description: CPU CPUGAD (CPU + PUGAD (Hiligaynon for “nest”)) Technology Business Incubator is hosted by Central Philippine University in Jaro, Iloilo City and serves Region VI (Western Visayas). Established through a ₱13.68 million grant from DOST-PCIEERD under the HEIRIT Program, CPUGAD TBI officially launched on 12 February 2025 as the only private university-based TBI in Region VI — bringing CPU's strengths in engineering and technology to the regional startup ecosystem.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-CapSU Agriculture & Aquaculture TBI
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-CapSU Agriculture & Aquaculture TBI — officially known as CAPSULE (Center for Advancing Partnerships, Stimulating Upscale and Leading Enterprises) — is hosted by Capiz State University in Roxas City, Capiz and serves Region VI (Western Visayas). Institutionalized in August 2018 under the DOST-PCAARRD Research, Development and Extension unit, CAPSULE is designed as the university's technology transfer and commercialization support facility for the agriculture and aquaculture sector.

Name: ISAT-U FabLab
Description: ISAT-U FabLab is a fabrication laboratory hosted by Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) in Iloilo City. The FabLab provides students, faculty, researchers, and local entrepreneurs with access to state-of-the-art digital fabrication equipment, enabling hands-on innovation, prototyping, and product development within the ISAT-U campus community.

Name: ISAT-U KWADRA Technology Business Incubator
Description: KWADRA TBI is the Technology Business Incubator of Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) in Iloilo City, supported by the Department of Science and Technology (DOST) under the HEIRIT (Higher Education Institution Readiness for Innovation & Technopreneurship) Program. Operating as one of Western Visayas' key DOST-accredited TBIs, KWADRA provides a structured innovation and startup incubation environment for students, faculty innovators, and community entrepreneurs in the Iloilo area.

Name: Western Visayas Food Innovation Center — Guimaras State University
Description: The Western Visayas Food Innovation Center at Guimaras State University (WVFIC-GSC) is a partnership between DOST Region VI and Guimaras State University (formerly Guimaras State College), established in 2016 at the GSU-Mosqueda Campus in Guimaras. It operates as the designated Food Innovation Center for Western Visayas — a one-stop-shop for the food processing industry in the region, addressing technology needs across the full value chain: process and product development, R&D, training and consultancy, laboratory and testing services, packaging assistance, and technology information.

Name: WVSU BINHI Technology Business Incubator (TBI)
Description: WVSU BINHI — Business Incubator Nurturing Homegrown Innovations — is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of West Visayas State University in La Paz, Iloilo City, and the university's flagship innovation hub for Western Visayas. It operates as a component unit of WVSU's Knowledge Technology Transfer & Business Development Center (KTTBDC), alongside the Innovation & Technology Support Office (ITSO) and the Knowledge & Technology Transfer Office (KTTO). BINHI incubates startups across biomedical & healthcare, agri-aqua & green technologies, emerging technologies/ICT, and herbal & natural products. As of early 2025 it had graduated 25 startups, generated 81 jobs, supported 13 active incubatees, and catalyzed ₱3M+ in investments and ₱5M+ in startup revenues.

Name: BALIK sa Bohol TBI
Description: BALIK sa Bohol TBI is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Bohol Island State University (BISU) in Tagbilaran City, Bohol, Region VII (Central Visayas). "BALIK" stands for Business Accelerators Linking Innovation and Knowledge, and the center serves as a platform for translating research and innovation into scalable, market-ready solutions while fostering collaboration among academe, industry, government, and local communities.

Name: Central Visayas Food Innovation Center — CIT-U
Description: The Central Visayas Food Innovation Center (CVFIC) is the region's DOST-designated Food Innovation Center (FIC), hosted by Cebu Institute of Technology – University (CIT-U) in Cebu City. As one of the nationwide network of DOST FICs, the CVFIC provides comprehensive food product development and processing support to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) across the Central Visayas region.

Name: CIT-U AI FabLab
Description: The CIT-U AI FabLab is an Artificial Intelligence Fabrication Laboratory hosted by Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) in Cebu City (Region VII). Launched on May 8, 2025, in partnership with the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) under the Shared Service Facility (SSF) Program, it is the first AI-integrated fabrication laboratory in Central Visayas and the eighth FabLab in Cebu. The facility was established through a government investment of approximately PhP4.98 million.

Name: CTU Center for Food Development & Technopreneurship (IFSIT) (IC)
Description: The Center for Food Development & Technopreneurship (IFSIT — Institute of Food Science and Technopreneurship) at Cebu Technological University is an RDE institute under CTU's College of Technology — it is not the DOST Region VII Food Innovation Center (that is the Central Visayas FIC hosted at CIT University). It is a multidisciplinary platform that bridges food science research and entrepreneurship, delivering technical services and R&D support to food-sector MSMEs, processors, and entrepreneurs across Cebu and the broader Central Visayas region.

Name: CTU-ATBI — DOST-PCAARRD Agri-Aqua TBI (Cebu Technological University)
Description: CTU-ATBI is the DOST-PCAARRD Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator of Cebu Technological University — a joint DOST-PCAARRD–CTU project that provides mentoring, business and technical know-how, and incubator space to startups and MSMEs using agri-aqua technologies, so they can become economically mature and sustainable.

Name: DigiFab – LGU Bogo City
Description: Host-agency logo (DTI Cebu) — DigiFab Bogo City is a DTI Cebu FabLab with no dedicated page.

Name: FabLab Bohol
Description: FabLab Bohol is the digital fabrication laboratory of Bohol Island State University (BISU), located in Tagbilaran City, Bohol. Listed on the global Fab Lab network directory (fablabs.io), the lab provides open access to fabrication equipment and digital design tools for students, faculty, community members, and local MSMEs across Bohol Island.

Name: FabLab CTU-Argao
Description: FabLab CTU-Argao is a digital fabrication laboratory established through a partnership between Cebu Technological University – Argao Campus and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) under the University Shared Facility (USF) Program. Located in Argao, Cebu, the lab is housed within the CTU-Argao campus and provides open access to digital fabrication technologies for faculty, students, communities, and micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs).

Name: FabLab CTU-Danao
Description: FabLab CTU-Danao is a fabrication laboratory hosted by Cebu Technological University – Danao Campus in Danao City, Cebu. Listed on the global Fab Lab network directory (fablabs.io), FabLab CTU-Danao provides students, faculty, MSMEs, and community members in northern Cebu with access to digital fabrication equipment for prototyping, product development, and innovation projects.

Name: FabLab CTU-Tuburan
Description: FabLab CTU-Tuburan is the digital fabrication laboratory of Cebu Technological University – Tuburan, located in the municipality of Tuburan in the western part of Cebu Island. Listed on the global Fab Lab network directory (fablabs.io), the lab provides open access to prototyping and fabrication equipment for students, faculty, community members, and local MSMEs in western Cebu.

Name: FabLab UP-Cebu
Description: FabLab UP-Cebu is the digital fabrication laboratory of the University of the Philippines Cebu (UP Cebu), located in Cebu City in the Central Visayas region (Region VII). Listed on the global fablabs.io directory, the lab extends UP's commitment to research, innovation, and public service to Cebu — one of the Philippines' most dynamic economic and creative centers — serving UP Cebu students, faculty, and the broader Cebu innovation ecosystem with professional-grade digital fabrication tools.

Name: Food Innovation Center — CTU Tuburan
Description: The Cebu Technological University Tuburan Food Innovation Center (CTU-TC FIC) is a food innovation and R&D hub established at CTU's Tuburan Campus in northern Cebu through the Department of Trade and Industry's University Shared Facility (USF) Program. The center is anchored within the Institute for Food Science, Innovation and Technopreneurship (IFSIT), which was established at CTU Tuburan in 2019, with the USF Food Innovation Center formally opened on December 10, 2021.

Name: HNU FabLab – Center for Innovation
Description: The HNU FabLab – Center for Innovation is a multidisciplinary fabrication and innovation hub hosted by Holy Name University in Tagbilaran City, Bohol (Region VII). Established with support from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) under the Shared Service Facility (SSF) Program, the center was formally launched on December 16–17, 2025, marking a milestone in advancing innovation, technology, and creative development in the province of Bohol.

Name: UP Cebu Business Incubator for Information Technology (UP Cebu inIT)
Description: InIT UP-Cebu (UP Cebu inIT) is the Incubator for Information Technology incubator hosted by the University of the Philippines Cebu in Cebu City. Operating under UPScale, UP Cebu's umbrella innovation platform, InIT supports pre-revenue and early-stage technology startups with a focus on software, digital services, and tech-driven social enterprises in the Visayas.

Name: WildCat Innovation Labs (CIT-U TBI)
Description: WildCat Innovation Labs is the Technology Business Incubator of Cebu Institute of Technology – University (CIT-U) in Cebu City, supported by DOST-PCIEERD. Named after the university's wildcat mascot, WildCat Innovation Labs serves as CIT-U's dedicated startup incubation and innovation center — supporting technology-based ventures in the Visayas, with a particular thematic focus on AI/ML, IoT, robotics, data analytics, and mechatronics.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-VSU Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator (VSU-TBI)
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-VSU Agriculture & Food TBI is hosted by Visayas State University in Baybay City, Leyte and is the first Technology Business Incubator established in Eastern Visayas. Strategically located adjacent to VSU's Technomart and Pasalubong Center, the TBI is designed to fast-track the translation of technologies developed by VSU and partner research institutions into commercial products ready for local and national markets.

Name: Eastern Visayas FIC (EV-FIC) — Eastern Visayas State University
Description: The Eastern Visayas Food Innovation Center (EV-FIC) is a joint initiative of the Department of Science and Technology and Eastern Visayas State University (EVSU), established at EVSU's campus in Tacloban City, Leyte. Launched on September 26, 2015, it operates as Region VIII's designated one-stop-shop for food processing innovation — serving MSMEs, food entrepreneurs, and researchers across Eastern Visayas with product development, technical training, and laboratory services.

Name: FabLab Eastern Visayas (PSHS-EVC)
Description: PSHS Eastern Visayas FabLab is a Shared Service Facility (SSF) funded by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), established at the Philippine Science High School Eastern Visayas Campus (PSHS-EVC) in Palo, Leyte. Located on the Ground Floor of the Crest Building at PSHS-EVC, Pawing, Palo, Leyte, it serves as a regional hub for digital fabrication, ideation, and innovation for MSMEs, students, makers, and researchers in Eastern Visayas.

Name: SSU TBI LAMBAT (Samar State University)
Description: LAMBAT Technology Business Incubator is the DOST-supported Technology Business Incubator of Samar State University (SSU) in Catbalogan City, Samar, focused on marine and food processing technology — reflecting SSU's position as the primary university serving one of the Philippines' most prolific maritime provinces. The name LAMBAT (Local Alliance of Marine-based Businesses and Food Technology) captures the center's identity as a net that gathers and nurtures innovations from Western Samar's fishing, coastal, and food processing communities.

Name: ANLAG TA BUKSU-TBI
Description: ANLAG TA BUKSU-TBI is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Bukidnon State University (BUKSU) in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon, Region X (Northern Mindanao). As one of the few university-based technology business incubators in Mindanao, it is designed to foster technology-driven entrepreneurship and innovation across the region, providing critical infrastructure, resources, and business support to new ventures.

Name: CDO BITES — CDO Business Incubation, Tech Entrepreneurship & Startups
Description: CDO B.I.T.E.S. (Business Incubation, Tech Entrepreneurship & Startups) is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the University of Science & Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP) in Cagayan de Oro, serving as the primary startup incubation and technology entrepreneurship platform for Northern Mindanao. As a DOST-accredited TBI, CDO B.I.T.E.S. provides structured incubation programs, mentoring, and business development support to student innovators, faculty entrepreneurs, and early-stage technology startups in Region X.

Name: DOST-PCAARRD-CMU Agriculture, Food & Natural Resources TBI
Description: The DOST-PCAARRD-CMU Agriculture, Food & Natural Resources TBI is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Central Mindanao University (CMU) in Maramag, Bukidnon. Established under the DOST-PCAARRD (Philippine Council for Agriculture, Aquatic and Natural Resources Research and Development) program, this TBI focuses on agri, food, and natural resources (AANR) innovation, supporting startups and researchers in commercializing agricultural and food technology solutions from one of Mindanao's premier agricultural universities.

Name: Food Research & Development Center — Central Mindanao University
Description: The Food Research & Development Center (FRDC) at Central Mindanao University is a DOST-10 partnered food innovation facility located in Maramag, Bukidnon. Established in 2016, the FRDC provides food entrepreneurs and MSMEs in Central Mindanao with technical assistance, food processing equipment, and product development services, functioning as a regional food innovation hub for Bukidnon and surrounding areas.

Name: MSU-IIT Center of Innovation and Technopreneurship (CIT) — iDEYA
Description: The Center of Innovation and Technopreneurship (CIT), branded iDEYA, is the Technology Business Incubator of MSU – Iligan Institute of Technology (MSU-IIT), recognized as the first DOST-PCIEERD funded university business incubator in Mindanao. Located in Iligan City, Lanao del Norte, ILIGANiCE was established to transform MSU-IIT's engineering and technology research into commercially viable startups — linking the region's academic talent to markets, investors, and the national startup ecosystem.

Name: MSU-IIT FabLab Mindanao
Description: The MSU-IIT FabLab Mindanao is the digital fabrication laboratory of Mindanao State University – Iligan Institute of Technology (MSU-IIT), one of the premier state universities in Northern Mindanao. Established as part of the global Fab Lab network, the center serves students, researchers, MSMEs, and innovators in Iligan City and the surrounding region by providing open access to advanced digital fabrication and prototyping equipment.

Name: Northern Mindanao FIC (NMFIC) — USTP
Description: The Northern Mindanao Food Innovation Center (NMFIC) is a DOST-funded Food Innovation Center hosted by the University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP) in Cagayan de Oro City. As the FIC serving Region X, NMFIC provides food entrepreneurs and MSMEs across Northern Mindanao with state-of-the-art food processing equipment, technical assistance, and product development services.

Name: USTP-CDO Design Engineering and Fabrication Laboratory (FabLab)
Description: The USTP Design Engineering & Fabrication Laboratory (USTP FabLab) is the digital fabrication center of the University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines, located at C.M. Recto Avenue, Lapasan, Cagayan de Oro City. As a member of the global Fab Lab network, USTP FabLab provides open access to state-of-the-art prototyping and design-engineering equipment for students, faculty, researchers, and MSMEs in Region X.

Name: AdDU ADDVentures Technology Business Incubator (TBI)
Description: ADDVentures Technology Business Incubator is the innovation incubation center of Ateneo de Davao University (AdDU) in Davao City, serving Region XI (Davao Region). Established through DOST-PCIEERD's HEIRIT (Higher Education Institution Readiness for Innovation and Technopreneurship) Program and formally inaugurated in February 2025, ADDVentures holds the distinction of housing the Philippines' first Aerospace and Robotics-focused Technology Business Incubator.

Name: Davao Food Processing Innovation Center — Philippine Women's College of Davao
Description: The Food Processing Innovation Center — Davao (FPIC-Davao) at Philippine Women's College of Davao holds the distinction of being the first Food Innovation Center established in the Philippines (May 2014), serving as the founding model for the nationwide DOST FIC network now operating across all regions. Hosted by PWC Davao in Davao City, the FPIC-Davao serves the Davao Region's (Region XI) food-sector MSMEs, agri-entrepreneurs, and processors with professional food technology access.

Name: DIGIHUB FabLab Davao
Description: DIGIHUB FabLab Davao is the digital fabrication laboratory of the University of Southeastern Philippines (USeP), located in Davao City. Listed on the global Fab Lab network directory (fablabs.io), DIGIHUB provides open access to fabrication equipment and digital design tools for students, faculty, researchers, and MSMEs in the Davao Region (Region XI). The center’s name — DIGIHUB — reflects its role as a digital innovation hub, combining fabrication capabilities with creative and technical support for the Davao startup and maker community.

Name: DNSC BUGSAI Technology Business Incubator
Description: DNSC BUGSAI (Blue Economy Underpinning Global Sustainability through Adaptive Innovations) Technology Business Incubator is hosted by Davao del Norte State College in Panabo City, Davao del Norte and serves Region XI (Davao Region). Established with a ₱13.4 million grant from DOST-PCIEERD under the HEIRIT Program, BUGSAI TBI was formally launched on March 20, 2025 — making it the first Blue Economy-focused incubator in Davao del Norte and the first TBI hosted by a fisheries school in the region.

Name: PWC CHI+ Technology Business Incubator
Description: Creative Hub for Innovation (ChI+) is the Technology Business Incubator of Philippine Women's College of Davao (PWC) in Davao City. A DOST-supported TBI, CHI+ focuses on technology and social innovation with a particular emphasis on health and women-centered entrepreneurship, reflecting PWC's historical mission as a leading women's educational institution in Southern Mindanao.

Name: UIC MARIAN Technology Business Incubator
Description: MARIAN TBI is the Technology Business Incubator of the University of the Immaculate Conception (UIC) in Davao City, established with DOST-PCIEERD funding of PHP 11.3 million under the Higher Education Institution Readiness for Innovation & Technopreneurship (HEIRIT) Program. Named as a backronym for “Mobilizing Advanced Research and Innovations to Advocate Nation-building,” MARIAN TBI focuses on nurturing health-technology startups and social enterprises that address the healthcare and wellness needs of Mindanao.

Name: UMasenso Hub
Description: UMasenso Hub is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the University of Mindanao (UM) in Davao City, operating under the UM Research and Innovation Center (UMRIC). The hub specializes in startups addressing environmental solutions — its designated banner sector — reflecting Davao City's strategic position as a center for environmental management, sustainable development, and climate resilience in Mindanao.

Name: UP Mindanao CORSAIR — AI & Robotics FabLab
Description: Host-office logo (UP Mindanao Office of Research) — CORSAIR FabLab has no dedicated page.

Name: Upgrade Innolab, Inc. (formerly UP Mindanao UPGRADE TBI)
Description: UPGRADE (University of the Philippines Mindanao Growing and Developing Enterprises) is the Technology Business Incubator hosted by the University of the Philippines Mindanao in Davao City, serving Region XI (Davao Region). Founded in 2019 through a grant from DOST-PCIEERD under the HEIRIT program, UPGRADE launched as UP Mindanao's dedicated incubation hub with a niche program centered on ICT for Sustainable Food Systems — one of the few university TBIs in the Philippines focused on the intersection of digital technology and food system innovation.

Name: USeP AGILab TBI (Advancing Great Ideas Laboratory)
Description: USeP AGILab TBI (Advancing Great Ideas Laboratory) is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the University of Southeastern Philippines (USeP), located in Davao City in Mindanao (Region XI). As USeP's flagship innovation and entrepreneurship hub, AGILab supports technology startups and student innovators in one of the Philippines' fastest-growing regional innovation ecosystems.

Name: ICEBOX TBI
Description: ICEBOX TBI (Innovation Center for Enterprises and Business Opportunities) is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Mindanao State University - General Santos (MSU-GenSan) in General Santos City, Region XII (SOCCSKSARGEN). Described as one of its kind in Region XII, ICEBOX is a DOST-assisted TBI focused on Smart Systems Innovations, providing startups with the support mechanisms and resources they need to transform ideas into prototypes and, ultimately, viable techno-entrepreneurial ventures.

Name: SOCCSKSARGEN FIC — Sultan Kudarat State University
Description: The SOCCSKSARGEN Food Innovation Center (FIC) at Sultan Kudarat State University (SKSU) is the first DOST Food Innovation Center in the SOCCSKSARGEN region (Region XII), established in 2022 and hosted by SKSU in Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat. The center serves food MSMEs and agri-food entrepreneurs of SOCCSKSARGEN — a region known for its pineapple, banana, coffee, and corn production — with food product development, processing, and packaging services.

Name: STEP APP TBI (SKSU)
Description: STEP APP — Sustainable Technopreneurship Ecosystem for the Promotion and Advancement of Promising Products — is the Technology Business Incubator hosted by Sultan Kudarat State University at its ACCESS Campus in Tacurong City, serving Region XII (SOCCSKSARGEN). It champions local startups in Industrial Technology and ICT for the Agriculture, Aquaculture, and Halal industries.

Name: USM-KCC FabLab
Description: The USM-KCC FabLab is the digital fabrication laboratory of the University of Southern Mindanao – Kidapawan City Campus (USM-KCC), located in Kidapawan City, Cotabato. As the first Fab Lab established in the SOCCSKSARGEN region (Region XII), USM-KCC FabLab plays a pioneering role in democratizing access to digital manufacturing and prototyping technology for students, researchers, MSMEs, and innovators in Central Mindanao.

Name: USMart TBI
Description: USMart TBI is the Technology Business Incubator (TBI) of the University of Southern Mindanao (USM) in Kabacan, North Cotabato, funded by DOST-PCIEERD as part of the national TBI network. The center supports student and early-stage startup teams working in the agri-food sector — aligning with USM's strengths in agriculture, applied sciences, and research in Central Mindanao.

Name: ASSCAT Agri-Food Processing and Innovation Center
Description: The ASSCAT Agri-Food Processing and Innovation Center at Agusan del Sur State University (formerly the Agusan del Sur State College of Agriculture and Technology) in Bunawan, Agusan del Sur is one of DOST Caraga's regional food innovation facilities, providing food processing, product development and technical services to agri-food MSMEs in the region.

Name: Caraga FIC — Surigao del Norte State University (SNSU)
Description: The Caraga FIC at Surigao del Norte State University (SNSU) is a DOST-funded Food Innovation Center located in Surigao City, Surigao del Norte. As one of the member institutions of the Caraga Food Innovation Consortium (CFIC), SNSU's FIC provides food entrepreneurs, MSMEs, and agri-based businesses across Surigao del Norte with access to specialized food processing equipment, product development expertise, and regulatory support.

Name: Caraga Food Innovation Center (FIC)
Description: The Caraga Food Innovation Center (FIC) is hosted by Caraga State University (CSU) in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte and is the lead facility of the Caraga Food Innovation Consortium (CFIC) — a collaborative regional network coordinated by DOST-Caraga that brings together multiple state universities across Region XIII. The CFIC partners include Agusan del Sur State College of Agriculture and Technology (ASSCAT), North Eastern Mindanao State University (NEMSU), and Surigao del Norte State University (SNSU), working together to establish satellite Food Innovation Centers across Caraga's provinces.

Name: DOST-SNSU WAVES TBI
Description: DOST-SNSU WAVES TBI is a university-based Technology Business Incubator hosted by Surigao del Norte State University (SNSU) in Surigao City, Region XIII (Caraga). It was established in partnership with the DOST-Philippine Council for Industry, Energy, and Emerging Technology Research and Development (PCIEERD) and DOST Regional Office Caraga, and was officially recognized during the 6th TBI Summit in November 2022 as part of Philippine Startup Week.

Name: FabLab Caraga
Description: FabLab Caraga is the digital fabrication laboratory of Caraga State University, located in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte. As a member of the global Fab Lab network (listed on fablabs.io), the lab provides open access to fabrication equipment for students, faculty, researchers, and MSMEs across the Caraga region. Operating under Caraga State University — the region's flagship state university — the FabLab supports applied research, prototyping, and innovation development for Caraga's communities, many of which are engaged in agriculture, forestry, aquaculture, and resource-based industries.

Name: FSUU Food Innovation Center (Caraga FIC)
Description: The FSUU Food Innovation Center is the Food Innovation Center (FIC) of Father Saturnino Urios University (FSUU) in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte — the newest member of the Caraga Food Innovation Consortium (CFIC), operating in coordination with DOST-Caraga. As one of the DOST-designated FICs in the country, the FSUU FIC provides food processing and product development services to MSMEs across the Caraga region, complementing the other members of the Caraga FIC network.

Name: Navigatu TBI (DOST-CSU)
Description: Navigatu TBI is the Technology Business Incubator of Caraga State University, supported by DOST-PCIEERD, located in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte. Taking its name from “navigation,” inspired by the Balangay boats of Butuan, Navigatu TBI serves as a compass for technology-based ventures in the Caraga region (Region XIII) — guiding innovators and startup founders through the journey from idea to enterprise.

Name: NEMSU Food Innovation Center
Description: The NEMSU Food Innovation Center at North Eastern Mindanao State University (formerly Surigao del Sur State University) is one of the five Food Innovation Centers operated by DOST Caraga (with CSU, SNSU, ASSCAT and FSUU). Its reported FIC activity is based at the NEMSU Lianga campus in Surigao del Sur; the university's main office is in Tandag.

Name: TARA Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator (Caraga State University)
Description: CSU TARA (Agri-Aqua Technology Business Incubator) Technology Business Incubator is hosted by Caraga State University in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte and serves Region XIII (Caraga). TARA is CSU's dedicated agri-aqua incubation arm — operating alongside the university's Navigatu (iTecH) incubator — and is specifically focused on the Agriculture, Aquatic, and Natural Resources (AANR) sectors relevant to Caraga's resource-rich environment.

Name: FabLab Negros — NORSU
Description: FabLab Negros is the digital fabrication laboratory of Negros Oriental State University (NORSU), located in Dumaguete City — the "City of Gentle People" and one of the Philippines' most vibrant university cities in Negros Oriental. Registered on the global fablabs.io directory, FabLab Negros represents NORSU's commitment to maker education, innovation, and technology access for students and MSMEs across the Negros Island Region.

Name: FabLab Siquijor
Description: FabLab Siquijor is the digital fabrication laboratory of Siquijor State College, located in Larena, the capital municipality of Siquijor in the Negros Island Region. As one of the more remote FabLabs in the Philippine national network, the center plays a crucial role in making advanced manufacturing and prototyping technologies accessible to the island province — extending digital fabrication access to students, entrepreneurs, and community members in an island traditionally known for its natural beauty, eco-tourism, and artisanal crafts.

Name: Pandayan ng Bayan — Metalworks & Fabrication Center
Description: Pandayan ng Bayan is a DOST Community Empowerment through Science & Technology (CEST) metalworks and fabrication project in Negros Occidental, implemented by Central Philippines State University (CPSU) with DOST Region VI funding. CPSU serves as the project's implementing agency; four other Negros state universities and colleges act as collaborating agencies, each leading one of the project's five components.

Name: SINERGY TBI (Silliman Innovations on Energy)
Description: SINERGY TBI (Silliman Innovations on Energy) is a Technology Business Incubator hosted by Silliman University in Dumaguete, Negros Oriental. Operating under DOST's banner program for Energy Technology, SINERGY TBI supports entrepreneurs, researchers, and student innovators developing solutions in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and sustainable power systems.

Name: TUPV HIVE — Hub for Innovation & Value Engineering
Description: The HIVE (Hub for Innovation & Value Engineering) is the DOST-funded Technology Business Incubator of the Technological University of the Philippines – Visayas (TUP-Visayas), located at the Antonio Chan Memorial Technical Training Center, Marapara, Brgy. Bata, Bacolod City, Negros Occidental. Established with DOST-PCIEERD funding under TUP-Visayas — a premier public technical university serving the Visayas region — HIVE provides startup incubation, prototyping support, and business development assistance to innovators and entrepreneurs in the Negros Island Region.
